question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Crocodile tears
solution:
The correct answer is: **False tears**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom "**Crocodile tears**" means tears that you cry when you are not really sad or sorry. (झूठे आँसू)

 
 
• Example - *They weep crocodile tears__ for the poor and disadvantaged, but are basically happy with things as they are.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Crocodile tears**" is "**False tears**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
